as_told.title: Randy Anderson sees triangle craft at Area 51

plain: A man named Randy Anderson says he has seen triangle-shaped craft at Area 51, the secret Air Force test site in Nevada, and believes they fly by electrogravitic propulsion, a proposed drive that would move a craft by working on gravity with electric fields. Michels relays this from Anderson, who told him off air and also told a researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb. The details shift between retellings: once Michels says Anderson saw triangles taking off, another time a single black triangle hovering over the test site, and Anderson says he can only presume the craft use that kind of drive.
